exposure: Delivery admissions without a diagnosis of COVID-19
Delivery admissions with a diagnosis of COVID-19
cohort: This study included 3,458,691 weighted delivery admissions from the 2020 National Inpatient Sample database, with 1.3% (n=46,375) having a COVID-19 diagnosis.
finding: Pregnant individuals with COVID-19 had a higher risk of preeclampsia, in-hospital mortality, and other serious cardiovascular complications during delivery hospitalizations compared to those without COVID-19.
